full_prompt_en: A square, finely lined portrait illustration shows a woman in three-quarter profile, her face inclined toward the lower left. Her skin is nearly ivory and very smooth, with a delicate dark brow, lowered eyes, a narrow nose, and small coral-red lips. Black hair is gathered low at the back of her head. A large broad-brimmed black hat sweeps from the lower left across the top of the image, shading her forehead and framing an orange blossom tucked into the hair at the upper right. A long, narrow pendant earring hangs beside the cheek. Her dark patterned collar and robe fill the lower right, edged with fine ocher lines and small cream botanical motifs. Oversized pale peonies crowd the background and lower left foreground. Their petals are mostly uncolored, described by precise gray-black contour strokes and sparse tonal hatching on warm paper. Small dark leaves sit between the flowers, and a faintly branching pattern remains visible in the upper background. The face is lit softly from the left, its pale open area standing out against the hat and dark garment. Shadow under the brim is controlled and thin rather than deep; the flower at the hair provides a concentrated warm accent. Ink-like outlines are sharper around the eyes, flowers, and clothing trim, while the skin is blended with little visible texture. The composition is tightly cropped and decorative, using a large diagonal hat shape and repeated rounded petals to guide the eye back to the quietly lowered face.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细线描绘的肖像插画呈现一位女子四分之三侧面，脸向左下微倾。肤色近象牙白且十分平滑，深色眉细致，眼睛低垂，鼻梁纤窄，嘴唇小而珊瑚红。黑发在脑后低低挽起。一顶宽檐大黑帽从左下扫过画面顶部，给额头遮阴，并围住右上发间的一朵橘色花。细长垂坠耳环沿面颊下挂。深色花纹衣领和外袍填满右下，边缘有细赭色线条与小块奶油色植物纹。巨大的淡色牡丹挤在背景和左下前景。花瓣基本不上色，主要由精确灰黑轮廓线和暖纸面上稀疏排线描述。花朵之间夹着小块深叶，上部背景还可见淡淡分叉纹。脸部受左侧柔光照亮，浅色开阔面在黑帽和深衣前突出。帽檐下的阴影薄而克制，并不深沉；发间橘花提供集中的暖色重音。眼睛、花瓣及衣饰边缘的墨线更锐利，皮肤则平顺融合，几乎不见肌理。构图裁切紧密而有装饰性，以大块斜向帽形和重复圆瓣，把视线带回安静下垂的面庞。
style_prompt_en: A refined ink-and-color illustration sets a large matte black sweep against warm ivory paper and finely outlined pale forms. Hairline dark contours describe overlapping rounded shapes; sparse gray hatching adds depth without filling the light areas. A small orange accent and thin ocher trim punctuate the mostly black, cream, and muted gray palette. The main pale focal zone is smoothly blended and nearly textureless, while surrounding patterned areas carry denser linework and tiny decorative marks. Edges are precise but not uniformly heavy: strong dark masses anchor the composition, and delicate lines preserve air within lighter passages. Soft side lighting lifts the pale center and leaves a narrow controlled shadow under the upper sweep. Tight cropping, a strong diagonal, and repeated curves make the image elegant and quietly rhythmic.
style_prompt_zh: 精致墨线与设色插画把大块哑黑色扫形放在暖象牙纸面和细线勾勒的浅色形块前。发丝般深线描出相叠的圆润形状；稀疏灰色排线增加层次，却不填满浅色区域。小块橘色重音与细赭色镶边点缀以黑、奶油色和低饱和灰为主的配色。主要浅色焦点平顺晕染，几乎无肌理；周围带纹样的区域则线条更密、装饰小痕更多。边缘精确却并非处处厚重：强深色团块固定构图，纤细笔线则让浅色段落保留空气。柔和侧光提亮浅色中心，在上方扫形之下留一道克制窄影。紧密裁切、强斜线和重复曲线让图像优雅而安静地起伏。
theme_en: A woman in a black hat among pale peonies
theme_zh: 淡色牡丹间戴黑帽的女子
name: Utamaro
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
